在核查完成之前，本批货物暂不能随附原产地证书或原产地声明，贵司暂不能申请适用中瑞自贸协定项下的协定税率。如核查确认符合要求，我司将及时通知贵司。

如需其他资料，敬请随时与我司联系。

此致
敬礼！

[出口商名称]
[日期]
back_translation_en:
Dear [Importer name],

We are checking the originating status of the product "Control valve RV-50 DN50 PN40" (HS code: 8481.80) that we export to your company against the rules of origin of the Free Trade Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Swiss Confederation (the "China-Switzerland FTA"); at present we cannot yet confirm that the product meets these rules of origin.

Until the check is complete, this shipment cannot be accompanied by a certificate of origin or an origin declaration, and your company cannot yet apply for the FTA (conventional) tariff rate under the China-Switzerland FTA. We will inform you promptly once the check confirms compliance.

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further documents.

Yours faithfully,

[Exporter name]
[Date]

letter_zh:
尊敬的[进口商名称]：

您好！我司谨此告知：我司向贵司出口的产品“Automatic wristwatch LF Automatique 40”（HS编码：9102.21）符合《中华人民共和国和瑞士联邦自由贸易协定》（以下简称“中瑞自贸协定”）的原产地规则，适用的产品特定原产地规则为：非原产材料价值不超过出厂价的40%；原产地证书所列原产地标准为“PSR”（使用非原产材料生产且符合产品特定原产地规则）。

本批货物将由瑞士直接运输至中国，运输单证可应要求提供。本批货物将随附原产地证明，即主管机构签发的原产地证书，或由经核准出口商出具的原产地声明。贵司在办理进口申报时，可凭该原产地证明向海关申请适用中瑞自贸协定项下的协定税率。

如需其他资料，敬请随时与我司联系。

此致
敬礼！

[出口商名称]
[日期]
back_translation_en:
Dear [Importer name],

We hereby inform you that the product "Automatic wristwatch LF Automatique 40" (HS code: 9102.21) that we export to your company meets the rules of origin of the Free Trade Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Swiss Confederation (the "China-Switzerland FTA"); the applicable product-specific rule of origin is: non-originating materials not exceeding 40% of the ex-works price; the origin criterion stated on the certificate of origin is "PSR" (produced using non-originating materials that satisfy the product-specific rule of origin).

The goods will be transported directly from Switzerland to China; the transport documents are available on request. This shipment will be accompanied by a proof of origin, namely a certificate of origin issued by the competent authority, or an origin declaration made out by an approved exporter. When making the import declaration, your company may present this proof of origin to customs and apply for the FTA (conventional) tariff rate under the China-Switzerland FTA.

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further documents.

Yours faithfully,

[Exporter name]
[Date]
